annotation.title_clean: Guidelines on transparency obligations for providers and deployers of certain AI systems
annotation.title_en: Guidelines on transparency obligations for providers and deployers of certain AI systems
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page introducing its guidelines on Article 50 AI Act transparency obligations. It outlines duties for providers and deployers on disclosing AI interaction, marking AI-generated content, deepfakes, emotion recognition, and how compliance may be shown, including via the Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-generated Content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Article 50 AI Act transparency obligations apply from 2 August 2026
Providers must inform users of direct AI interaction and add machine-readable marks to AI-generated content
Deployers must disclose emotion recognition, biometric categorisation and unreviewed public-interest AI text
Compliance can be shown via the Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-generated Content or equivalent means
Enforcement by national market surveillance authorities, AI Office and EDPS
